outcome: Adapt and verify the selected local Apple starter for the project's actual user task.

criteria.title: Build and launch the iOS/iPadOS app on the selected supported SDK and configuration
Build and launch the native macOS app and use menus, keyboard and Settings
Storage read/write failures preserve user work and never replace unreadable data with an empty store
Selected phone, resizable iPad and Mac layouts remain usable with large text and accessibility input
Valid deep links open the right context; invalid links do not mutate data or discard drafts
Create, search, open, edit and favorite the correct record by stable ID; changes persist after reopening
Cancel and delete show the declared outcome; unsaved edits and failed saves remain recoverable
Both widget extensions build with the intended signing/App Group and read only the published summary
Small, medium and large widget states keep privacy, timestamp/fallback and valid app navigation without promising an exact refresh time
